messages:
sara_support: Heads-up — Greenleaf Analytics blocked billing. Procurement will not accept an invoice until we submit a signed PO and vendor onboarding form. They've flagged VAT handling as 'exempt' and want our tax cert + company registration. They explicitly said pro-forma won't work. Any quick path to unblock?

ben_billing: Can confirm — we can't send a final invoice without an official PO on their side. We can prepare a pro-forma, but if procurement explicitly refused that, the only safe option is to wait for a PO. Do we have a history of scanned POs being accepted from them?

nina_sales: @sara_support looping in Sales Ops. Greenleaf negotiated Net30 but their procurement policy requires a PO before any invoice generation. Their buyer's note: 'require PO number and signed cost allocation sheet.' I'll ping the buyer for a scanned PO and cost center code.

james_accounting: For AR mapping we need the PO number in the format `PO-GL-YYYY-XXXX` if possible, but any unique PO number works. If they provide a scanned signed PDF with buyer name, PO number, date, and cost center, we can accept and redate the invoice. If they still need vendor onboarding first, we need their vendor packet returned.

sara_support: They attached this line from procurement: 'we cannot accept invoices until vendor onboarding is complete; please provide certified tax docs and signed PO.' They said SOW or contract alone is insufficient.

ben_billing: Short-term workaround suggestion: issue a clearly labelled pro-forma ("PRO-FORMA — not for payment") with line items and total to help their internal approvals. Note: procurement said they won't accept pro-forma, but sometimes it speeds approvals. If we do this, add an explicit note that final invoice will be issued once a valid PO is received.

procurement-bot: FYI: Company policy (Vendor Onboarding) requires vendor packet + tax docs for first-time vendors or spend > $10k annually. Escalate to Legal if customer requests invoicing before completion.

nina_sales: I'm on it with the buyer now. Quick question for Accounting: is an emailed scanned PO (PDF) with an electronic signature acceptable, or do they insist on a wet signature?

james_accounting: Scanned signed PO (PDF) is acceptable if it contains buyer name, PO number, date, and cost center. Save it in the contract folder and we can reissue the invoice dated today attaching the PO. If they also send vendor packet, we'll process vendor onboarding in parallel then finalize AR.

sara_support: Great — Nina, please push for the scanned PO + cost center. Ben/James, hold invoicing until we receive the PO; if we only get the vendor packet first, Accounting will prepare steps to onboard and then invoice. I'll update once buyer responds. :pray:
